... I asked him
what the plans were for V:TES. He said that once the license was up,
WotC

thinks

confirms rumors that V:TES would be dropped by Wizards...

Please make a statement. Will V:TES be continued or not? And:
will your support be continued or not?

Michael Beer, Dortmund, Germany
